text.tspan: One possible successful execution, not a globally synchronized timeline.
Order history and notifications are separate reads.
The browser may see shipped status before its notification appears.
Fulfillment and notifications run in independent consumer groups.
Publishing OrderShipped does not wait for acceptance notification creation
or for the notifications consumer to commit its offset.
